locations.note: A Spartan mercenary fights for both sides of the Peloponnesian War across Classical Greece.
The story begins on the island of Kephallonia.
The city of Perikles and Sokrates, where the Eagle Bearer finds Phoibe, the plague and the Cult's hold on the assembly.
The Peloponnesian War story includes the Spartan homeland.
The northern Aegean island is a distinct explorable region.
The northern campaign includes the Macedonian region.
The Agora of Athens is where Kassandra or Alexios meets Perikles and Sokrates.
The Oracle at Delphi sets the hunt for the Cult of Kosmos in motion.
The Olympic Games at Olympia, under the statue of Zeus, are a story stop.
The story begins with the fall from Mount Taygetos in Sparta.
The Eagle Bearer finds their mother Myrinne ruling Naxos under the name Phoenix.
The game opens in 480 BC with Leonidas holding the pass at Thermopylae against the Persians.
The first contract: kill the Wolf of Sparta in Megaris.
At the Battle of Pylos the Eagle Bearer meets Deimos and is captured.
The Labyrinth beneath Knossos on Crete holds the Minotaur, an Isu experiment.

routes.name: The Eagle Bearer
routes.note: From a mercenary's life on Kephallonia the misthios hunts the Cult and the lost family through Megara, Delphi, Athens, Naxos and Pylos to a reunion in Sparta.
